This objective forms the core of amortized variational inference in my model, extending standard VAE frameworks to continuous-time stochastic processes ( [ 23 ] ; [ 8 ] ). A central mathematical challenge in this setting is computing or estimating the KL divergence between pathwise distributions. When both the prior and variational families are defined via SDEs, the KL divergence becomes an integral over drift mismatches, as justified by Girsanov’s theorem ( [ 15 ] ). An original contribution of my method lies in augmenting the ELBO with a pathwise regularization term that penalizes excessive divergence in latent trajectories.
